column1: # Websites worth keeping a copy of, archived as library titles by a server.
# Columns, separated by single tabs: id, group, address, ZIM name, title (30 characters
# at most), page limit, note. The crawl stays beneath the address given.
#   sudo offline queue site uk          every site in the uk group
# Each is published under the Open Government Licence v3.0, which permits copying
# with acknowledgement of the source. The NHS asks that syndicated copies be kept
# current, so archive it again every few months. The archiver fetches two pages at a
# time and identifies itself, to avoid burdening the sites.
# Put your own sites in /etc/offline/sites.local.tsv using the same layout.
